goal: Allow developers to run reproducible Guix builds natively on RISC-V architectures
Prevent build failures caused by unsupported dependencies and broken package tests on riscv64 hosts
agreement: Verified identical Guix build hashes across updates on x86_64 (fanquake, willcl-ark, Sjors)
Approved after discussion clarified skipping package tests in the manifest (maflcko)
Requested documenting the NSIS changes and clarifying which related packages fail (fanquake)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because native Guix builds currently fail on riscv64 hosts due to unsupported package dependencies.
Enables reproducible release builds on RISC-V hardware, which remains a niche development environment.
